findings.title: Recently closed TCP sockets were mistaken for active listeners
findings.resolution: The native readiness probe now uses SO_REUSEADDR, accepting TIME_WAIT while continuing to refuse an active listener.

findings.title: Declared sampling settings and seed did not consistently reach native generation
findings.resolution: Request construction forwards the chosen sampling profile, rejects explicit drift and verifies the actual native generation settings per response. The matched pair was restarted after correction.

findings.title: A 200-message API limit rejected valid conversations far below the token limit
findings.resolution: Conversation validation now follows configured context while preserving the 2 MiB body limit and exact rendered-token/output reservation checks. A real 202-message Qwen request returned READY.

findings.title: Back-to-back GPU samples could disagree during authorized Bonsai teardown
findings.resolution: Native admission retries the same strict zero-utilization/10500-MiB-free check for at most 60 seconds. Persistent occupancy and unknown layouts remain rejected; unknown jobs are not stopped.

findings.title: The detector missed a real module-before-options unittest command
findings.resolution: Both python3 -m unittest -v test_scheduler and python3 -m unittest test_scheduler -v are recognized, including .py and protected workspace/stderr forms. A frozen-log audit proves oldFalse/newTrue. The original timeout/failing-code verdict stays rejected; both compatibility arms were repeated in fresh directories.

findings.title: The qualifier assumed the native health shape for the frontend response
findings.resolution: The qualifier now checks the actual single-model discovery body, model identity and nonempty process nonce. A real HTTP-handler RED control reproduced the error; substituted/duplicate/status-only records remain rejected. The corrected complete real pair returns not_promoted for model-quality failures.

findings.title: Stopped clients verified identity before their final provider request drained
findings.resolution: Drain already-issued requests before model discovery; preserve deadline/timeout verdicts. Stop only own labeled project containers before source hashing and independent grading, then verify cleanup again. Both client harnesses have real HTTP RED/GREEN controls; the original incomplete flow record is retained and a fresh compatibility baseline is required.

scope: Implementation fixes and model quality are separate. Exact selected HE9 is not all-164 HumanEval or official EvalPlus parity. Source/identity checks do not establish frontier-model equivalence.

additional_capabilities.authenticated_adapter_continuation: Completed non-smoke parent; verified recipe/files/base/rank/scale/scope/targets; exact FP32 loaded tensor equality before memory probe; explicit new optimizer.
additional_capabilities.evidence_scope: CPU controls establish loader, trainability, grounding and split behavior. Full measured Qwen results remain separately gated.

continuation_output_budget_finding.observation: Hermes omits max_tokens/max_completion_tokens. The serving validator falls back to1024; all18 malformed calls stop at1024 with stop_type=limit. The8192 value is the server cap, not this effective request budget.
continuation_output_budget_finding.next_step: Set an explicit larger client budget, record it in comparison identity, and rerun both compatibility arms before attributing remaining failures to model quality.

portable_release_preflight.scope: CPU shape-only base standard PeftModel.from_pretrained configuration/injection and exact factor loading. Target matrices use expanded FP32 scalar placeholders solely for CPU placement and exact FP32 loading. No base checkpoint weights, inference or GPU use.
portable_release_preflight.precision_note: PEFT can round factors through BF16 when the base target weights are BF16; this exactness control deliberately uses FP32. Native measured inference retains the published F32 GGUF factors.
